arena_declaration.drawing_relation: drawn iff a UNIQUE transport element carries a -> b (R1's relation verbatim); the drawing group is <gamma>, fixed across the whole grid -- only the declared cell structure varies
arena_declaration.coset_order_convention: H-orbits ordered by minimum label; ALL = every c-subset, BLOCKWISE = disjoint consecutive windows, SLIDING = every cyclic window of length c

locality_census.criterion: locality exists at a rule iff SOME connected component of that rule's overlap graph is NOT complete (the R1 adjudication's criterion, section 6)

positive_control.declaration: two coset-union cells sharing exactly one label, hand-declared OUTSIDE the grid (pin section 6)

scramble_control.tested_set: every grid rule with F(N) > 0 -- fixed by declaration, never selected by the verdicts under audit

parity_witness.tested_set: every grid rule at B with a cell of three or more labels -- fixed by declaration

alt_drawing_group_probe.note: the pin fixes the drawing relation across the grid (only the cell structure varies); this probe records what would happen if <gamma,Sigma> were used as the DRAWING group instead
alt_drawing_group_probe.reason: a drawn pair forces a trivial stabiliser, so |T| must divide and equal an orbit size; |<gamma,Sigma>| exceeds the label count at both transports, so nothing is drawn

verdict.head: R2-LOCALITY-AT
verdict.declared_scope: at the single block B (TB3's native 8-label arena via I6) and at B2 (two blocks plus basepoint), over the exhaustively enumerated declared atlas grid of 109 rules at two declared transports

theorems.R2-A: drawn <=> b in orbit(a) and orbit(a) regular; the drawn relation at a cell is a disjoint union of complete graphs on the regular orbits.  Re-proved in the paper, verified at 10 actions with 0 counterexamples.
theorems.R2-A-coherence: a drawn pair forces a trivial stabiliser, so the three drawn maps of any 2-cell compose to the identity: N_coh = N identically (FORCED, disclosed).
theorems.R2-partition: an atlas whose cells PARTITION the labels can never produce a non-complete component; locality requires cells that overlap partially (G0/G1/G3-ORBITS verified clique-only).
theorems.R2-C-inherited: the R1 gateway phi < 1 is forced by the basepoint; R2 does not use phi (anchor A-R1-ADJ).

gates.name: G-DRAW-TWO-ROUTES

gates.name: G-R2A-AT-THIS-UNITS-ACTIONS

gates.name: G-R2A-EXHAUSTIVE

gates.name: G-R2A-NULL-CLIQUE-ONLY
gates.statement: the G0 null (regular <gamma>-orbits) returns clique-only components at every transport and arena -- the R2-A theorem check

gates.name: G-ORBIT-CLASSES-CLIQUE-ONLY
gates.statement: every orbit-partition class (G0, G1, G3-ORBITS) returns clique-only components: disjoint cells cannot make a non-complete component

gates.name: G-COMPONENTS-TWO-ROUTES
gates.statement: b0 by union-find equals |V| - rank(d1) over F_2 at every rule and arena

gates.name: G-COMPLETENESS-TWO-ROUTES

gates.name: G-COHERENCE-FORCED
gates.statement: every 2-cell of N is coherent at every rule and arena: a drawn pair forces a trivial stabiliser, so the three drawn maps compose to the identity (FORCED -- entered as a disclosure, #208)

gates.name: G-UNDEFINED-PATH-LIVE
gates.statement: the b2-density UNDEFINED path is reached by shipped inputs (F_COH=0) and is recorded with its reason -- not dead code

gates.name: G-STANDARDS-CONTROLS
gates.statement: the reimplemented standards see I3's controls: the 2-sphere and the 2-torus return every-link-a-circle, the pinch point does not

gates.name: G-STANDARDS-CONTROL-BETTI
gates.statement: the controls' Betti numbers reproduce I3's table exactly

gates.name: G-STANDARDS-IDENTITIES
gates.statement: sum_v star_E(v) = 2|E(N)| and sum_v star_F(v) = 3|F(N)| at every rule where the standards are measured, and the per-cell dimension agrees with an independent component census

gates.name: G-COPY-REDUCTION
gates.statement: the per-block reduction is VERIFIED, not assumed: at every rule the additive counts at B2 are exactly twice B's and all three densities are unchanged (the copy-forcing theorem's content at this scale)

gates.name: G-B2-PERSISTENCE-MEASURED

gates.name: G-POSITIVE-CONTROL
gates.statement: the hand-declared toy (two cells sharing exactly one label) returns a NON-COMPLETE component -- the criterion's instrument has teeth

gates.name: G-MODES-DISTINCT
gates.statement: SLIDING and BLOCKWISE build different cell sets at every grid coordinate that declares both -- checked through the very function the rules use, so a mode collapse is fatal.  Where SLIDING and ALL coincide it is a MEASURED coincidence (it happens exactly at c = |orbits| - 1, where a cyclic window omits one coset) and is counted, not gated away.

gates.name: G-SCRAMBLE-CONTROL
gates.statement: scrambling the drawn maps MOVES the identification-sensitive measure (coherent 2-cells) at a positive number of rules and FIXES the component census at every rule of the declared tested set

gates.name: G-SYMMETRY-SELFTEST
gates.statement: the census is invariant under every declared relabelling of the arena (cells and transport conjugated together), evaluated FRESH with the memo bypassed

gates.name: G-CACHE-EXERCISED
gates.statement: the memo path is exercised on both branches (a zero-hit or zero-lookup cache gate is vacuous, RUNBOOK #219)

gates.name: G-BOUNDARY-PARITY
gates.statement: the Boolean connective at the 2-cell boundary is witnessed: over the declared tested set the alternative connective (any-pair-drawn instead of pairwise-drawn) has a non-zero measured delta at a positive number of rules, and every delta is printed

gates.name: G-ALT-DRAW-PROBE

gates.name: G-LATTICE-CROSSCHECK

mutants.name: census-corrupt
mutants.what_it_breaks: drops one drawn edge from a rule's census

mutants.name: complete-flip
mutants.what_it_breaks: flips the per-component completeness verdict, and the rule's locality flag with it, at a locality-bearing rule

mutants.name: refuses-skip
mutants.what_it_breaks: skips rules that draw nothing instead of recording REFUSES

mutants.name: verdict-pair-swap
mutants.what_it_breaks: swaps two verdict segments' names against their values

mutants.name: table-corrupt

mutants.name: orbit-corrupt
mutants.what_it_breaks: corrupts the orbit machinery at the G0 null

mutants.name: locality-erase
mutants.what_it_breaks: collapses SLIDING onto BLOCKWISE, erasing all locality

mutants.name: locality-inject
mutants.what_it_breaks: injects a spurious non-complete component at the null

mutants.name: toy-broken

mutants.name: scramble-inert

mutants.name: census-row-corrupt
